sql_log.purpose: Measure the exact frozen caller population, key completeness and declared-edge denominator.
sql_log.sql:
with callers as (
 select x
 from public.lf_eventos e
 cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x
 where e.id=20161
)
select
 count(*) as caller_rows,
 count(distinct x->>'caller') as distinct_callers,
 count(*) filter (where nullif(x->>'caller','') is null) as caller_missing,
 count(*) filter (where nullif(x->>'definition_md5','') is null) as hash_missing,
 count(*) filter (where not ((x->>'definition_md5') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$')) as hash_invalid,
 coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(x->'callees')),0) as declared_edges,
 count(*) filter (where jsonb_array_length(x->'callees')=0) as zero_callee_callers,
 jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(x->>'operational_class','<NULL>'),1) as class_presence,
 jsonb_agg(distinct x->>'currentness_source') as currentness_sources
from callers

sql_log.purpose: Test post-cut exact existence and ambiguity for every frozen caller and trigger name.
sql_log.sql:
with hcall as (
 select split_part(x->>'caller','.',1) as nspname,split_part(x->>'caller','.',2) as proname
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x
 where e.id=20161
), htrg as (
 select t->>'trigger' as trigger_name,t->>'table_name' as table_name,t->>'function' as function_name
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'trigger_bindings') t
 where e.id=20161
), call_match as (
 select h.*,count(p.oid) as matches
 from hcall h left join pg_namespace n on n.nspname=h.nspname
 left join pg_proc p on p.pronamespace=n.oid and p.proname=h.proname
 group by h.nspname,h.proname
), trg_match as (
 select h.*,count(t.oid) as matches
 from htrg h
 left join pg_trigger t on t.tgname=h.trigger_name and not t.tgisinternal
 group by h.trigger_name,h.table_name,h.function_name
)
select
 (select count(*) from call_match) as frozen_callers,
 (select count(*) from call_match where matches=0) as caller_absent,
 (select count(*) from call_match where matches>1) as caller_overloaded,
 (select count(*) from trg_match) as frozen_triggers,
 (select count(*) from trg_match where matches=0) as trigger_absent,
 (select count(*) from trg_match where matches>1) as trigger_name_ambiguous,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trigger',trigger_name,'table_name',table_name,'function',function_name,'matches',matches) order by trigger_name)
  from trg_match where matches<>1) as trigger_exceptions

sql_log.purpose: Measure a transparent post-cut name-pattern complement without claiming it is the total consumer universe.
sql_log.sql:
with hist as (
 select x->>'caller' as caller
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x
 where e.id=20161
), current_related as (
 select n.nspname||'.'||p.proname as object_name,p.oid,
        pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as identity_args
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
   and (p.proname ilike '%input_governance%' or p.proname ilike '%input_readiness%')
)
select
 count(*) as current_name_pattern_objects,
 count(*) filter (where h.caller is not null) as exact_p0_name_matches,
 count(*) filter (where h.caller is null) as current_pattern_not_in_p0,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('object_name',c.object_name,'oid',c.oid,'identity_args',c.identity_args)
           order by c.object_name,c.oid) filter (where h.caller is null) as complement
from current_related c
left join hist h on h.caller=c.object_name

sql_log.purpose: Search a bounded current static complement for functions outside P0 that textually reference four core anchors.
sql_log.sql:
with hist as (
 select x->>'caller' as caller
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x
 where e.id=20161
), lexical as (
 select n.nspname||'.'||p.proname as object_name,p.oid,
        (lower(p.prosrc) like '%fn_input_governance_execute%'
         or lower(p.prosrc) like '%fn_input_readiness_run_is_current%'
         or lower(p.prosrc) like '%fn_input_governance_bootstrap_classify%'
         or lower(p.prosrc) like '%fn_input_governance_semantic_probe%') as anchor_reference
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
)
select count(*) as lexical_objects_outside_p0,
       jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('object_name',l.object_name,'oid',l.oid) order by l.object_name,l.oid) as objects
from lexical l
left join hist h on h.caller=l.object_name
where l.anchor_reference and h.caller is null
